regulation: Interregional cooperation agreement on packaging waste
article_ref: Cooperation Agreement of 4 Nov. 2008, Art. 6 (take-back, >300kg) and Art. 18 (reporting)
title: Belgium: IVC declaration and Fost Plus or Valipac membership
summary: A business placing at least 300 kg of packaging on the Belgian market per year registers through the Interregional Packaging Commission (IVC/CIE) and joins Fost Plus for household packaging, Valipac for industrial packaging, or both. Below 300 kg/year, neither the take-back nor the reporting duty in the Cooperation Agreement's own text applies.

required_evidence.label: Fost Plus or Valipac membership confirmation

sources.title: Cooperation Agreement of 4 November 2008 on the prevention and management of packaging waste (Belgian Official Gazette 29.12.2008)
sources.note: Fetched the treaty text directly (English version). FINDING that changes the picture from the 13 Sept draft: the Agreement's OWN text sets Art. 6's take-back obligation (join Fost Plus/Valipac or self-fulfil) at 'at least 300 kg of packaging on the market per year' -- there IS a threshold in the primary source, contrary to this draft's original summary ('There is no de minimis threshold'), which was carried over from IVC/CIE's own English guidance page. Art. 18's annual reporting duty is worded as applying to 'the responsible company subject to the take-back obligation', i.e. the same 300 kg-gated population in the treaty text -- not, as the guidance page states, 'any company placing packaged products on the Belgian market' regardless of volume. DECISION (Tabeen Raoof, 2026-09-20, PR #6 review): 'Trust the treaty text over the vendor's "no de minimis" claim. Update the draft to enforce the 300 kg limit.' RESOLVED by adding organisation.be_packaging_kg_previous_year >= 300 to applies_when, same shape as the NL row in this batch (nl.epr.packaging-verpact), and rewriting the summary to match.

sources.title: Interregional Packaging Commission (IVC/CIE) — reporting obligation page
sources.note: States plainly: 'Any company placing packaged products on the Belgian market' has the reporting obligation, with no volume threshold mentioned. Kept as a source of record even though the treaty text above is what applies_when now follows -- it may reflect a later amendment or informal practice, but per Tabeen's review the primary text governs.
